notes.title: Elnea's 10th Anniversary Campaign Vol. 3: Elnea 50% OFF!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45271013/dcc3532629f12a635d1a478a0112176fd081e4fe.jpg[/img]

We're currently holding an Anniversary Campaign to celebrate the 10th Anniversary of "WorldNeverland - Elnea Kingdom"!
As the third phase of our campaign, the latest title in the series, "WorldNeverland - Elnea Kingdom" (main game), will be 50% off for a limited time! You can get it at half price for 3 days only, from May 24th to May 26th (the 10th anniversary day)!
Don't miss this special opportunity to start your life in Elnea, a game beloved by players worldwide!

notes.title: WorldNeverland: Daily Life in the Elnea Kingdom is Finally on Steam!
notes.content:
WorldNeverland: Daily Life in the Elnea Kingdom is now available on Steam!

Experience the freedom of life simulation in the virtual kingdom of Elnea. Fall in love, marry, work, and embark on adventures as you create a legacy that spans generations.

Celebrate the Steam launch with a 25% discount for the first 14 days! 

Highly acclaimed on smartphones and Nintendo Switch, WorldNeverland: Daily Life in the Elnea Kingdom now brings its unique charm and features to PC. Don't miss out on this opportunity to start your new life in Elnea!

notes.title: Bug Fixes [Ver1.0.1]
notes.content:
Thank you for playing World Neverland - The Story of the Olerud Kingdom.

We have taken measures to address the following issues.

- On rare occasions, the game may crash and an error may occur, making it impossible to resume.

We apologize for the inconvenience, but please update the game.

We will continue to work hard to ensure that everyone can enjoy the game comfortably, so we appreciate your continued support.
